mintAuthority.summary: YLDS has native issuer-controlled issuance on Provenance and Stellar. Provenance marker uylds.fcc has five direct ACCESS_MINT accounts plus a zero-delay 4-of-6 group policy, and enabled chain governance can change marker supply controls or native marker logic after the documented fastest 86,400-second expedited vote. The Stellar issuer account has no on-chain issuance cap. Solana and Ethereum are Hastra wYLDS bridge/wrapper representations and are excluded from Mint Authority.

controls.label: YLDS Provenance 4-of-6 marker admin and mint policy
controls.capDescription: Marker supply_fixed is false and marker supply=0 is not a cap. Current marker-module max_supply is 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 atomic units (1,000,000,000,000,000,000 YLDS at six decimals); this is a module-wide maximum, not a marker-specific fixed cap. The group cannot raise it; governance can change marker supply controls.
controls.evidence: At Provenance height 32896122 on 2026-08-16, this address held both ACCESS_MINT and ACCESS_ADMIN on marker uylds.fcc. It is the self-administered Cosmos group policy 722 with a 0.51 threshold requiring four approvals, a 172,800-second voting expiry, and min_execution_period=0. The current group-members endpoint reports six equal-weight members: pb1r44zwv54vq3hfsgluls35x2dfsfq3za7wfhr86, pb18pzq9ec7205tvqyv9jermdyyjntchntveleurz, pb1wx27dz7w6h93rnqzrq77ac9a693c6p0868306w, pb1wg524vz2mnws2a89lnzl67387qtdk4ddkwq2kh, pb1skfxqc4a7ujc6cn63fh6xt8xt2zewtxlfld7z8, and pb1a89ssd97nwasgf9dez0rz0y8qtqa4vtw2yr0vh. Execution can occur immediately after the fourth approval; the voting period is not a timelock.

controls.label: Provenance chain governance marker and runtime authority
controls.evidence: At Provenance height 32896122 on 2026-08-16, marker uylds.fcc had allow_governance_control=true and marker-module governance was enabled. Provenance proposal-handler source permits governance to change marker access and supply and to replace native chain logic through a software-upgrade proposal. The documented fastest enforced governance path is the 86,400-second expedited voting period; the current group policy's normal voting period is 172,800 seconds. Governance can change the module-wide marker limits or authorize a different mint surface.

controls.label: YLDS Stellar issuer account
controls.capDescription: The Stellar issuer account has no on-chain issuance cap; the YLDS asset is not AUTH_IMMUTABLE and is controlled by the issuer account's signing authority.
controls.evidence: At Horizon ledger 63985854 on 2026-08-16, issuer account GAC7MOPTQLQUM3KC24AW4GHS3RLF72LPEZO54AH7EZ6TSMGRB5SOAVH3 had AUTH_REQUIRED, AUTH_REVOCABLE, and AUTH_CLAWBACK_ENABLED; AUTH_IMMUTABLE was false. Its low, medium, and high thresholds were all zero with only the account itself as a weight-1 signer, so Stellar issuance is directly controlled by the issuer account without an on-chain cap. The ledger does not establish legal key custody, signer-rotation policy, or off-chain Figure reconciliation.

review.evidence: At Provenance height 32896122 on 2026-08-16, marker uylds.fcc was active, restricted, floating (supply_fixed=false), and governance-enabled. Its current ACCESS_MINT set was one self-administered 4-of-6 group policy plus five individual BaseAccounts; the group policy has a 0.51 threshold, 172,800-second voting period, and zero execution period. Current Provenance bank supply was 653,417,340.573583 YLDS. The marker-module max_supply was 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 atomic units (1,000,000,000,000,000,000 YLDS at six decimals), not a marker-specific fixed cap, and documented governance can change marker supply controls or native runtime after the fastest one-day expedited vote. At Horizon ledger 63985854, the Stellar issuer account had AUTH_REQUIRED, AUTH_REVOCABLE, and AUTH_CLAWBACK_ENABLED, with AUTH_IMMUTABLE false and zero account thresholds around its sole self-signer; Stellar therefore adds a separate native issuance path with no on-chain cap. Legal key custody and off-chain Figure reconciliation are not inferable from the ledger. Cross-chain representations are excluded from this native review and remain under Bridge Risk.
